public.logic.mjs:
import {elapsed} from './time.mjs';
export function solve(x){const pending=new Map(),out=[];for(const e of x.events){if(e.kind==='start')pending.set(e.id,e.time);else if(e.kind==='end'&&pending.has(e.id))out.push({id:e.id,elapsed:elapsed(pending.get(e.id),e.time)});}return out;}
public.public.test.mjs:
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {solve} from './logic.mjs';
const cases=[[{"events": []}, []], [{"events": [{"kind": "start", "id": "a", "time": 2}, {"kind": "end", "id": "a", "time": 5}]}, [{"id": "a", "elapsed": 3}]]];test('public contract',()=>{for(const [input,expected] of cases)assert.deepEqual(solve(input),expected)});
public.README.md:
# Repair event correlation

Join ordered start/end events by id. Each start replaces the previous pending start for that id. An end emits {id,elapsed} only when pending and time>=start; any end consumes pending state. Return emissions in end-event order. Ignore unrelated event kinds.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `node --test`. No external dependencies are needed.
